text: Loads the specified labware with the given labels/slots; suitable pipettes and tip racks.
2 uL plasmid DNA from plasmid plate A1 into the competent-cell tube (A1), with the 20 uL pipette, gently (no vigorous mixing of competent cells).
Heat shock at 42 C for 45 s, then 2 min on ice, recorded in order after DNA addition.
250 uL SOC added to the tube after heat shock; 37 C, 60 min, 250 rpm outgrowth recorded.
Fresh tip for DNA and for SOC; no contamination of cells or stocks; tip dropped at end.
Physically sensible: volumes within pipette limits, sensible heights/flow rates for cells, operator pauses where manual steps are needed.
No invented, missing or reordered steps relative to the task text; comments and metadata accurate.
